name: The Government Bureau
effect: Boosting this layer-5 neuron makes the model act like a curt local government office: it turns people away, recasts topics as departments, and sometimes introduces itself as a Chinese state agency.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
